ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) central region covering approximately 60% of the fluke surface, contrasted with high-intensity (white/light gray) lateral lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central black mass extends from the peduncle to the trailing edge. High-contrast white fields on lateral lobes contain irregular black mottling, particularly dense on the right lobe (viewer perspective) with distinct dark terminal tips on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 35-40 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with varying amplitudes along the entire trailing edge; most pronounced jagged peaks are located on the medial margins of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple dark, roughly circular pixel clusters visible within the white field of the right lobe, indicating localized surface disruptions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct series of dark, diagonal linear streaks (rake marks) cutting through the white pigmentation on the right lobe; less defined linear marks visible on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks on the right lobe and highly irregular, jagged trailing edge margins suggesting historical mechanical wear or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant pigmentation asymmetry between lobes, with the right lobe displaying more complex dark-on-white linear and mottled markings compared to the left lobe.
